verdict.rationale: No evidence pack item mentions retention policy configuration, scheduled auto-deletion of transcripts/recordings, or an on-demand permanent erasure/right-to-delete workflow for IT admins. The only adjacent items are audit trails/access control (otter-docs-19, otter-docs-20) and a training-data opt-out (otter-docs-43), none of which address retention scheduling or deletion. Missing for 10: documented retention/auto-delete scheduling controls, an admin-facing data deletion/purge tool or API, evidence of on-demand permanent erasure capability.
